intro.text: Someone who is both a Misting and a Ferring. Twinborn first arose after the Final Ascension, once the Terris people mixed with the other people of the Final Empire.

description.text: The same mixing diluted Feruchemy, producing Ferrings. Holding both powers has practical uses: a Bloodmaker can heal inside a speed bubble, and a Coinshot can add Feruchemical weight.
Twinborn also have resonances, effects that come from their two powers combining.
